bases covered, 160 you feel a little bit short, I thought we gave it a good crack with the

hit some good shots. We were kind of squeezing them. The surface nice greenish look 
to it, the first couple of overs that Deepak bowled, couple of balls got stuck in. We 
decided to use change of pace balls. As soon as we figured out, we trying to mixing it 
up. We executed the yorkers very smartly well. [On Will Jacks] He can be a gun fielder.
